claim_evidence.arithmetic_obstruction: Distinct roots alpha,beta of the quadratic must satisfy (alpha/beta)^d=1 and give trace in K.
claim_evidence.geometric_reduction: Equality of weighted Hilbert functions forces standard grading; extreme lex generators force I=(f,x^d) with y^d in I.
claim_evidence.minimal_degree: For odd d the smallest prime factor p yields minimal real cyclotomic trace degree (p-1)/2.
claim_evidence.rational_real_classification: Rational root-of-unity trace has order 2,3,4, or 6; any real root-of-unity trace supplies an explicit ideal.

integrity.nature_of_contribution: Arithmetic existence over general characteristic-zero fields and optimal number-field degree; not the complex edge-scheme theorem.
integrity.source_date_basis: arXiv:1110.1861v1 publicly posted 2011-10-09 UTC; primary published paper keywords start with MSC 14C05.

scientific_limitations: Only opposite 2-by-d colength-2d monomial rectangles in the plane Hilbert scheme, characteristic zero.
No general T-graph classification or positive-characteristic extension is asserted.
The d=5 field-dependence example and the complex rectangular edge scheme are prior results.
A possible unindexed earlier formulation of the sharp arithmetic threshold remains an originality risk.
title: Arithmetic field thresholds for opposite rectangular Hilbert-scheme torus edges
